description: This file defines the 'LoginServices' class, which provides various static methods related to user login, authentication, password management, impersonation, and security handling within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for user login, password updates, user creation, impersonation controls, and security info updates, utilizing OFBiz's entity and service APIs, as well as external authentication helpers.

classes.name: LoginServices
classes.description: A collection of static methods providing login, authentication, user management, and security services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: userLogin
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password or token, manages login state, and records login history.

methods.name: userImpersonate
methods.description: Allows a user to impersonate another user, respecting security constraints, and logs the impersonation event.

methods.name: checkImpersonationControls
methods.description: Validates whether impersonation is allowed based on security policies and user permissions.

methods.name: createUserLogin
methods.description: Creates a new user login record, with optional password hashing and security permission checks.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password for an existing user login, performing validation and security checks.

methods.name: updateUserLoginId
methods.description: Changes the user login ID (username), deactivating the old login and creating or updating the new one.

methods.name: updateUserLoginSecurity
methods.description: Updates security-related information for a user login, such as enabled status and disabled date.

methods.name: checkNewPassword
methods.description: Validates a new password against various password policies, history, and pattern requirements.

methods.name: createUserLoginPasswordHistory
methods.description: Records a password change in history and enforces limit on stored past passwords.

methods.name: getHashType
methods.description: Returns the configured hash type for password encryption, defaulting to SHA.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Compares a stored password hash with a provided password string to verify correctness.

methods.name: tomcatSSOLogin
methods.description: Performs a Tomcat SSO login using HttpServletRequest, handling exceptions and authentication states.
